library(DBI)
library(odbc)
library(dplyr)
library(lcmm)

# 1. Connect to SSMS
con <- dbConnect(odbc::odbc(), Driver = "SQL Server", Server = "YOUR_SERVER", Database = "YOUR_DB", Trusted_Connection = "True")

# 2. Track total batches available in the queue (Will read 1 to 98 based on active site allocations)
batch_indices <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT DISTINCT universal_batch_id FROM Production_Batch_Queue ORDER BY universal_batch_id")$universal_batch_id

# 3. Execute the Production Loop
for(b_id in batch_indices) {
  
  message(paste("🚀 Executing Global Batch ID:", b_id, "out of", max(batch_indices), "at", Sys.time()))
  
  # Stream data for the current batch
  current_batch_data <- tbl(con, "Production_Batch_Queue") %>%
    filter(universal_batch_id == b_id) %>%
    collect()
  
  # Track the origin site name for the final data log
  site_name <- current_batch_data$assigned_study_site[1]
  
  # Run the joint model
  model_fit <- tryCatch({
    Jointlcmm(fixed = eGFR ~ observation_time, mixture = ~ observation_time,
              random = ~ observation_time, subject = "patient_id",
              classmb = ~ baseline_bp + baseline_dm + baseline_mental_health * imd_quintile,
              survival = Surv(time, status) ~ mixture(cohort), 
              hazard = "3-quant-splines", hazardtype = "CompetingRisks",
              data = current_batch_data, ng = 3, B = m1)
  }, error = function(e) { NULL })
  
  # If the model converges successfully, write the parameters straight back to SQL Server
  if(!is.null(model_fit)) {
    target_idx <- grep("baseline_mental_healthModerate/Severe:imd_quintile1", names(model_fit$best))
    
    # Structure a single row data frame to export
    output_row <- data.frame(
      universal_batch_id = b_id,
      assigned_study_site = site_name,
      interaction_log_odds = model_fit$best[target_idx],
      interaction_variance = diag(model_fit$V)[target_idx],
      timestamp = as.character(Sys.time())
    )
    
    # Append the row to a master table in SSMS
    dbWriteTable(con, "Meta_Analysis_Output_Log", output_row, append = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Free local system RAM entirely before the next batch streams in
  rm(current_batch_data, model_fit)
  gc()
}

dbDisconnect(con)
